all_completion_and_external_effects_reso.mechanism: every integrate-or-refuse decision resolves to one immutable receipt that is a pure function of its inputs: there is no clock and no random draw, the caller supplies created_at, and the gate id and receipt hash re-derive byte for byte from the receipt's own published fields, so replaying a call reproduces the receipt

governing_schemas_authority_boundaries_f.mechanism: the gate validates no schema of its own but binds each composed sub-receipt to the sealed gate's own exported GATE_NAME, re-derives each sub-receipt hash, reads each sealed decision against that gate's own ADMIT/ADVANCE/CONVENE token, takes the candidate-generating roles from the verifier firewall, and every FINDING_CODE names an exact refusal

happy_negative_crash_resume_adversarial_.mechanism: the happy path integrates and replays deterministically; each of a candidate-generating requester, a sub-receipt of the wrong gate, a tampered sub-receipt, a receipt for a different candidate, a Parliament receipt claiming promotion authority, two downstream gates on different clearances, and each of the three sealed decisions failing to clear is refused; crash/resume maps to replay determinism for this pure module, and the two adversarial disguises (re-sealing a tampered field, swapping in a different-but-valid clearance) are both refused

no_candidate_model_prompt_backend_or_hoo.mechanism: nothing here scores, selects, promotes or evaluates; a candidate-generating requesting role is refused with the set the verifier firewall declares, integration_grants_promotion is an always-False predicate, the composed Parliament receipt is re-checked against parliament_grants_promotion and refused if it claimed otherwise, and promotion authority lives in governance.promotion and takes no score from this gate
